Except for the BCC/B2 composite precipitates, a high density of the nanoscale γ′ phase with L12 structure and stoichiometry of (Ni, Co, Cr)3(Al, Nb) is produced in the Al4Nb2 MEA, which significantly increases the strength of the alloy.
This result indicates that the formation of nano-twins is the dominant deformation mode for the CrCoNi MEA, corresponding well with previous literatures
The deformation mode appears to be dominated by stacking faults (SFs), indicating that after addition of Al or Al, Nb, the deformation mode of the MEAs changes from deformation twins to SFs.
